integration.title: Your settling-in map
integration.subtitle: Twelve short questions, once in a while. You see how you are finding your feet in Finland, branch by branch.
integration.incomeHint: Monthly take-home income of your whole household, after taxes. Optional.
integration.privacy: Your answers are private: nobody else sees them, not even other users or employers.
integration.consent: Count my answers in anonymous city statistics (only shown for groups of at least 10 people). This helps cities see what works.
integration.saved: Saved. See you at the next check-in!
integration.dimensionsHint: Each branch is 0–100. They grow as you build ties, learn the language and get around the system — there is no pass or fail.
integration.empty: Take your first check-in to draw your map. It takes about two minutes.
integration.source: Based on the IPL-12 integration index by the Immigration Policy Lab (Harder et al., PNAS 2018), adapted for Finland.

questions.municipality_id: Which city do you live in?
questions.target_language: Which national language do you use or learn?
questions.connection: How connected do you feel with Finland?
questions.outsider: How often do you feel like an outsider in Finland?
questions.see_doctor: In Finland, how difficult or easy would it be for you to see a doctor?
questions.search_job: In Finland, how difficult or easy would it be for you to search for a job (find the right listings)?
questions.dinner: In the last 12 months, how often did you eat dinner with Finns who are not part of your family?
questions.contacts: Think about the Finns in your phone contacts. With how many of them did you have a conversation in the last 4 weeks?
questions.pol_understanding: How well do you understand the important political issues facing Finland?
questions.pol_discuss: In the last 12 months, how often did you discuss major political issues facing Finland with others?
questions.read_lang: How well can you read and understand the main points of simple newspaper articles on familiar subjects in {{language}}?
questions.speak_lang: How well can you speak about familiar topics and express personal opinions in a conversation in {{language}}?
questions.work_status: Which of these best describes what you have been doing for the last four weeks?
questions.household_size: How many people live in your household, including you?
questions.household_income: What is your household's total monthly income after taxes?
questions.stay_intention: How likely is it that you will still live in Finland two years from now?

work_status.1: In paid work or running my own business (even if temporarily away)
work_status.9: In integration training or a language course
work_status.3: Unemployed and actively looking for a job
work_status.8: Parental leave or caring for children or others

ventures.title: My ventures
ventures.subtitle: Started something? Add your company by its business ID. We check it in the Finnish Trade Register, so your passport and the city statistics show real, verified ventures.
ventures.metOnPlatform: Our team met or came together on EXPAT
ventures.source: Company data: Finnish Patent and Registration Office (PRH), open data, CC BY 4.0. We re-check it weekly.
ventures.empty: No companies yet. When you register one — a café, a studio, a startup — add it here.
ventures.inviteQuestion: You were added as a co-founder. Is that right?

network.title: My connections
network.subtitle: People you actually met: at events, in tandems, in the time bank, in city challenges or through a quick high five.
network.myCodeHint: Met someone? Let them scan this with their phone camera, or tell them the code. Showing it means you agree to connect.
network.rotated: New code created; the old one no longer works
network.noConnections: No connections yet. Go to an event, join a tandem or a city challenge — or simply high-five someone you met.
network.noEvents: At an event, scan the organiser's QR code or enter the check-in code above.
network.noIntros: Intros from co-founder matches appear here. Send one from Team Up → Matches.
network.introFrom: {{name}} would like to get in touch
network.introAccepted: Connected! You can now see each other's email.
network.marksSaved: Saved. You will be connected when they mark you too.
network.endorseHint: Vouch for something you have seen them do. Endorsements appear in their skills passport.
network.qrHint: Guests scan this with their phone camera to check in. Check-in is open from the day before until the day after the event.
network.noAttendees: Nobody else has checked in yet. Come back later to mark who you talked to.
network.whoDidYouMeet: Who did you talk to? You get connected when they mark you too.

scan.highFiveHint: You are now connected. You will find each other under My connections.

settling.title: How long does settling in take?
settling.hint: Optional. Tell us roughly when you arrived — then the dates you tick steps off show how long each one took, and your city can see where newcomers get stuck.
settling.consent: Count my dates in anonymous city statistics (groups of 10+ only)

tandems.title: Language tandems
tandems.subtitle: Practise Finnish or Swedish with someone who speaks it — and help them with your language in return. Coffee, a walk, a call: you decide.
tandems.levelsHint: Levels follow the European CEFR scale: A1 beginner … C2 near-native. Update them as you grow; we keep the history.
tandems.visible: Show me to people looking for a tandem partner
tandems.accepted: Tandem started! Find them under My connections.
tandems.noSuggestions: Add a language you are learning to see people who can help. New partners appear as more people join.

timebank.title: Time bank
timebank.subtitle: An hour for an hour. Help someone with Kela forms, get help with your CV. Everyone starts with 3 hours so newcomers can ask first.
timebank.confirmed: Confirmed. Thank you for helping each other!
timebank.noListings: Nothing here yet. Be the first to offer an hour!
timebank.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Help with Kela and tax card forms
timebank.recordReceived: Record the time {{name}} spent helping you.
timebank.recordGiven: Record the time you spent helping {{name}}.
timebank.proposed: Recorded. It counts once they confirm.

challenges.title: City challenges
challenges.subtitle: Your city shares a real problem. Team up with other residents, propose a solution — the best ideas go to participatory budgeting.
challenges.teamHint: Or join one of the teams below. Teammates appear in your connections.
challenges.ideaSummary: What, for whom, how it works, what it needs
challenges.ideaLink: Link to slides or a doc (optional)
challenges.noTeams: No teams yet — start the first one!
challenges.promoted: The idea is now in budget voting
challenges.empty: No challenges in this city yet. They are published by city staff.
challenges.challengeDescription: Context, who it affects, what a good solution looks like

passport.title: Skills passport
passport.subtitle: Proof of what you have done in Finland, confirmed by the people you did it with. Share it with a future co-founder, employer or a grant program.
passport.emptyOwn: Your passport fills up as you take part: check in at events, join a tandem, help in the time bank, team up in a city challenge.
passport.endorsements: Skills vouched for by people they met
passport.verified: Everything here was recorded on EXPAT and confirmed by other people or official registers — nothing is self-declared.
passport.shareHint: Only people with the link can see it. Turning sharing off makes old links stop working.
passport.notFound: This passport is not shared, or the link has been turned off.
passport.publicSubtitle: Verified activity on EXPAT, the platform for people building their life in Finland.

impact.title: Measured impact
impact.subtitle: What changes for people who use EXPAT — integration, real-world ties, companies founded and mutual help. Anonymous and live.
impact.hidden: Shown once at least {{count}} people have shared their answers.
impact.stayLikely: Likely to stay in Finland 2+ years
impact.connectedUsers: People with at least one real-world tie
impact.settlingTitle: Time to settle (median days from arrival)
impact.method: Live data, updated every 10 minutes. Answers count only with a separate opt-in, and any figure built from fewer than 10 people is hidden. Integration: IPL-12 (Immigration Policy Lab). Bridging ties: local bridges in Granovetter's sense. Companies: PRH open data (CC BY 4.0).

meetups.title: Open meetups
meetups.subtitle: Meetups that members run themselves: a Saturday speaking club, a call every other week, a walk. Start your own or just show up.
meetups.organizeHint: Pick a time and a place or a call link. It is your meetup, not an event by the platform: you decide the format.

fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Who it is for, what level, what to bring

meetups.linkPrivate: Only people who sign up see the link.
meetups.linkAfterJoin: Link appears after you sign up
meetups.timezone: Times are Finnish time. Repeating meetups happen on the same weekday as the first date.
meetups.endAfterStart: The meetup has to end after it starts.
meetups.created: Published. You are on the list as the organizer.
meetups.empty: No meetups here yet. Start one: a regular slot is often all it takes.
meetups.joined: You are on the list. See you there!
meetups.cancelConfirm: Cancel this meetup for everyone? It disappears from the list.
